facts.fact: Telkom's Openserve created an edge data centre at its Yzerfontein cable landing station as a pilot and sold space there to local and international customers, per Openserve executive Sunil Piyarlall (no date given; article date used).

Openserve's Sunil Piyarlall says Telkom, between Openserve and BCX, has 10 large data centres, three of them Tier 4 (operator statement, facilities not named, certifying body not given; article date used).
